entries.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI

entries.title: Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
entries.summary: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.
